Welcome to Swarm a Pet! 

CODES: 
SUPERSWARM
HARVEST
DRAGON
Next Code @ 500 Likes!

🐾 Lead a swarm of tiny creatures and pile onto giant pets until they fall asleep.
🏠 Your swarm carries them home, where they wake up in your pen and earn you cash, even while you're offline!
🌽 Feed your machine to pop out more creatures. The bigger your swarm, the bigger the pets it can carry!
😈 Steal pets from other players while they carry them home... and don't let them steal yours!

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite the game!

🎁 Join the group for a FREE gift!
